answer: Weight influence by stake-maturity, not raw stake size: a bond's voting and earning power ripens only with the unbroken calendar time it sits locked, gathered drop by drop like nectar, and every action spends down that accrued coin-age. A freshly spawned clone begins at the nadir, zero maturity, and splitting one pool of capital across many keypairs splits its age too, so a swarm's total ripened weight stays capped by wall-clock time that no parallelism can compress. The ledger, struck epoch by epoch with an incorruptible quill, lets no identity forge age it never waited out.
